name: security-sso-jit-membership-review
intent: SSO just-in-time organization and role assignment
artifacts: Tenant discovery, assertion/claim mapping, verified domain policy and provisioning/role assignment implementation.
trace: Follow issuer-controlled and user-controlled attributes into organization selection and role grants. Determine which IdPs are trusted for which tenant authority.
experiment: Use owned tenants/IdPs with a controlled domain or role collision and inspect resulting membership/capabilities server-side.
disproof: Creating an ordinary account through an allowed IdP is expected; a domain string without a granted membership is not tenant takeover.
repair: Constrain issuer-to-tenant/role mappings and retest authorized JIT entry and unauthorized membership assignment.
branch_decisions: An email-domain string is not necessarily verified domain control. Establish which issuer is trusted to assert which organization and role. Existing-user account linking and new-user JIT admission are distinct transitions; accepting a new low-privilege user does not prove administrative membership or existing-account takeover.
